messages:
oliver: Hey team — need quick approval path for a partner-sourced deal (Synergy Alliances). Partner wants a white-label bundle at a blended price with a 30% off for first 3 months + co-marketing credit. Deal summary: $180k ARR expected if pilot converts. Asking for a special pricing carveout for 6mo pilot. Can finance sign off?

mia: can you paste the proposed pricing lines and partner commission? need to calc impact.

oliver: sure — pasted from the quote draft: ```
SKU: WL-BUNDLE-STD x1 — list $15k/mo -> partner price $10.5k/mo (30% for 3mo)
One-off co-marketing credit: $25,000
Partner commission: 15% on net new ARR
Term: 6mo pilot then convert to 12mo preferred
Contract ID: SY-2026-024
```

kevin: quick read — baseline math: 3mo discounted delta ~ $13.5k (total), plus $25k credit = ~$38.5k hit in first 3mo. With 15% commission on $180k ARR that's another ~$27k paid out over time. Margin will be tight on FY26 forecasts.

kevin: Finance rule of thumb: we prefer one-off credits vs. recurring list-level discounts to protect unit economics. If we can push the partner to accept a non-recurring onboarding credit (booked as contra-revenue) and a smaller recurring discount, i'm more comfortable.

sasha: revops flag — if we do a recurring list discount we need altered billing SKU mapping and revenue recognition notes. Also need to confirm partner resell classification (will they invoice customers or we bill direct). That changes how commission is handled.

oliver: partner will resell under their brand (white-label). they want to handle customer billing. they asked us to invoice partner monthly net-30.

anna: legal — white-label + reseller = we need an addendum for indemnities + limit the special pricing to this named partner and term. Also require language to prevent retro discounts. I can draft.

oliver: what's the approval threshold? this feels like a deal-desk request. Mia, do we have delegated authority for one-off credits up to $30k?

mia: delegated authority: finance can approve credits up to $20k without exec. Anything >$20k needs RevOps+Head of Finance sign-off. If there's contract carveout/legal risk, escalate to Legal and Revenue Ops as well.

kevin: propose this path: 1) Convert the 30% recurring discount into a $25k one-time onboarding credit + 10% recurring discount for first 3mo. 2) Cap partner commission to 10% for the pilot term only, with step-up after conversion. 3) Legal addendum limiting discount to SY-2026-024 and stamping "no retro discounts" clause. If partner agrees, finance can approve (kevin + mia).

oliver: partner ok with that structure? they sign LOI today saying yes to onboarding credit but pushing back on commission cap.

kevin: if commission remains 15% we need to reduce the onboarding credit to keep the initial cash impact < $30k, otherwise this requires Head Finance or CFO sign-off.

oliver: updated numbers from partner call: they accept 10% commission for pilot, confirm onboarding credit $25k, will sign 12mo conversion at same list price after pilot if KPIs met.

dealbot: Approval request created: https://dealdesk.internal/review/SY-2026-024 — requested approvers: kevin (Finance), mia (SalesOps), anna (Legal).

kevin: reviewed deal desk — economics ok under the proposed structure. Approving conditional on Legal addendum and RevOps billing mapping. :thumbsup:

anna: i'll draft the addendum today and include language: "Special pricing applies to Synergy Alliances only for the Pilot Term (6 months). One-time onboarding credit of $25,000 is non-recurring and non-transferable. No retroactive discounting. Partner resale billing to be governed by Section 7 addendum." :eyes:

mia: i'll update billing and SKU mapping once anna pushes addendum. RevOps will set up a separate contract code so this doesn't affect global price books.

oliver: thanks — sounds like we have a path. kevin, mia — can you both confirm final sign-off here so i can close the LOI?

kevin: finance sign-off: APPROVED (conditional) — final when Legal confirms addendum language.

mia: SalesOps sign-off: APPROVED — will own billing mapping and contract code.

anna: Legal sign-off: DRAFTED and OK to sign once parties countersign LOI. i'll upload the addendum to docu and notify when ready.

oliver: great. i'll send LOI and route to partner for signature. tagging for visibility: @sasha fyi — double-check revenue ops flows after addendum.

sasha: got it. will run billing test and confirm commission schedule. :+1:

oliver: thanks team — looping in partner AM to finalize. will update thread with signed docs. :party_popper:
